create_timestep_embedding: create sinusoidal timestep embeddings for diffusion models using get_timestep_embedding with a given embedding dimension
build_2d_positional_embedding: build 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings for image tokens using get_2d_sincos_pos_embed with a grid size
generate_3d_positional_embedding: generate 3D sinusoidal positional embeddings for video tokens using get_3d_sincos_pos_embed with spatial and temporal sizes
apply_rotary_embedding: apply rotary positional embeddings to query or key tensors using apply_rotary_emb with precomputed frequency tensors
create_patch_embedding: create a PatchEmbed module to convert 2D image latents into patch embeddings with sinusoidal positional embeddings
